# openwebui_skill (Data Source)

Looks up an existing skill by its `skill_id`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `skill_id` (String) Identifier of the skill to look up.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Markdown body of the skill.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of creation.
- `description` (String) Short description of the skill.
- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by Open WebUI.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the skill is available to models.
- `name` (String) Display name of the skill.
- `public_read` (Boolean) Whether every signed-in user can read the skill.
- `public_write` (Boolean) Whether every signed-in user can write the skill.
- `read_groups` (List of String) Read-access group names currently applied to this skill.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags applied to the skill.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of last update.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user identifier.
- `write_access` (Boolean) Whether the authenticated user has write access.
- `write_groups` (List of String) Write-access group names currently applied to this skill.
